# FLORA / TREE RENDERING PIPELINE MAP

There are **THREE** parallel expansion paths that must all agree bit-for-bit: (A) React editor preview, (B) compiled `/compiled` game-file loader, (C) native live-paint preview inside the map editor. All ride the shared `eachPaintedCell` walk (JS) / chunk-flora walk (native).

## PALM PIPELINE (end-to-end)

**Painter kind → density** — `cart/hmsc-int/floraData.ts`: kinds `palmSparse/palmMed/palmDense` defined in the `FloraKind` union (:25-27), `FLORA_KIND_DEFINITIONS` labels/colors (:51-53), assigned lane `'tree'` in `FLORA_KIND_LAYER` (:65-67).

**Roll + placement** — `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/palmPopulation.ts`:
- `PALM_CONFIG` all palm globals (:25-42): density per level (:31), trunkHeight/Radius (:32-33), fronds count (:35), frondLen (:36), root tint (:38-39), `trunkColor` (:41).
- `PALM_KIND_DENSITY` maps the three tiles → sparse/med/dense (:47-51).
- `eachPalm` (:104-129): density gate `unit(seed) > PALM_CONFIG.density[level]` (:109) — most cells stay bare (grove look); rolls trunkH/radius/frond count/len/leanYaw/root/jitter off one hash chain.
- `crownRing` (:78-95) = the frond arc math: `yaw = (i/count)*360 + (i%2)*14`, `pitch = pitchBase + (i%3)*12`, per-frond length jitter, `wide = len*0.55` (:89-93). Two rings: drooping outer @ pitchBase 40, steeper shorter inner (0.6× count, 0.62× len) @ pitch 18, lifted `frondLen*0.12` (`buildPalmInstances` :150-153).
- `PALM_TRUNK_UNIT_RADIUS = 0.13` (:21) — the unit-space trunk radius the scale divides by.

**Frond card geometry** — `runtime/geometries/Frond.ts`: arched card, spine `y = t - sag·t²`, `z = arc·t²`, tapered halfW (:58-62). `FROND_DEFAULTS` = feathered coconut (arc 0.8, sag 0.18) (:40); also `FLOWING_FROND_DEFAULTS`/`BROAD_FROND_DEFAULTS` exist (:42-44) but are unused. **Leaf style is baked into `uv.u`'s integer band** (feathered=0, broad=10) (:49) — decoded shader-side.

**Frond shader look** — `framework/gpu/shaders.zig` `frond_wgsl` (:1406-1558): TRS rebuild from slim instance (:1460-1473); per-frond "spaghetti" curve seed so no two fronds match (:1474-1490); tip-weighted wind, slower than grass, 50-60m animation cut (:1491-1505); fragment leaf cutout — **feathered** rachis+leaflets branch (:1522-1531) vs **broad** split-leaf branch (:1532-1537); root→tip color gradient from per-instance tint (:1540-1544).

**Trunk geometry** — `runtime/geometries/PalmTrunk.ts`: `PALM_TRUNK_DEFAULTS` baseRadius 0.13 (:28-30); taper + low bulge + scar-ring ripple + lean in `at()` (:42-48). Native twin `world_loader.zig` `buildPalmTrunk()` (:1063), 1680 verts.

**Editor path (A)** — `cart/hmsc-int/render3d/GrassField.tsx`: `PalmFrondField` uses `buildPalmFrondInstances` + `Geometry.Frond`/`~frond~` (:90); `PalmTrunkField` uses `buildPalmTrunkInstances` + `Geometry.PalmTrunk`, no tex key (:93-94). Mounted in `GameWorld3D.tsx` (:185-188).

**Compiled path (B)** — `cart/hmsc-int/compile/worldGeometry.ts`: `pushPalms` bakes trunks as real `INSTANCE_SHAPE_PALMTRUNK` rows but recipe-izes the crown (:1225-1228). `encodeFlora` writes the FLORA lump including `palmCells` (specId=`FOLIAGE_SPEC_PALM`=3) (:1337-1359). Loader `world_loader.zig` recipe loop: `spec_id == 3` regenerates the crown via `foliage.palmCrown`/`palmFrondRow` into the `~frond~` batch, never enumerating rows (:1403-1413). Native crown math twin: `framework/world/foliage.zig` `PALM` config (:173-182), `palmCrown` (:199-224), `palmFrondRow` (:228-245).

**Native live-paint path (C)** — `world_loader.zig` `regenPaintFoliage` spec 3 branch (:7204-7231): re-rolls trunk (density-gated) + crown off the same hash chain.

**Palm-HARDCODED vs parameterized:**
- **Hardcoded names/ids**: `palmSparse/Med/Dense` keys, `FOLIAGE_SPEC_PALM=3` / `spec_id==3` literal in the loader (`world_loader.zig:1403`) and `regenPaintFoliage` (`:7204`), and `engine.zig` `FloraSpec.spec` clamps to `@min(3,…)` (`framework/game/map/engine.zig:908`) — a hard cap of 4 families.
- **Single frond LOOK hardcoded**: only the feathered coconut frond is ever emitted — `FROND_DEFAULTS` (Frond.ts:40), native `buildFrond` bakes feathered constants (`world_loader.zig:987-991`). The broad style exists in the shader but nothing emits it.
- **Bark color hardcoded**: `PALM_CONFIG.trunkColor` (palmPopulation.ts:41) / `PALM_TRUNK_COLOR` (`world_loader.zig:97`).
- **Parameterized** (all in `PALM_CONFIG`, editor-tunable via `editorTunables` :57-70): trunk height/radius, frond count/length, root tint.

## GRASS VS BUSH — "bush is just taller grass" CONFIRMED

**Geometry (the one real difference)** — `runtime/geometries/GrassBlade.ts` vs `BushClump.ts`:
- Grass fans quads over a **half-circle** `theta=(b+0.5)/count·π`, straight up, normal horizontal (GrassBlade.ts:37-42). Defaults blades 3, width 0.14 (:26).
- Bush fans cards a **full circle** `·π·2` AND **splays tips outward** (`tipX=dx·splay`) with normals tilted up 0.6 for volume (BushClump.ts:32,39-47). Defaults cards 5, width 0.5, tipTaper 0.3, splay 0.5 (:21).
- Native twins: `buildGrassBlade` 36 verts vs `buildBushClump` 60 verts (`world_loader.zig:892,948`).

**Spec** — `grassPopulation.ts`: `GRASS_CONFIG` height 0.26-0.55, width 0.8-1.35, density 3/7/16 (:37-47); `BUSH_CONFIG` height 0.7-1.6, width 1.4-2.4, density 6/14/26 (:53-61). Native: `foliage.zig` `GRASS` (:56-63) / `BUSH` (:66-73). Both run through the **same** `populateFoliage` roll via `GRASS_SPEC`/`BUSH_SPEC` (:127-128).

**Shader — IDENTICAL.** Both route `~grass~` → `grass_wgsl`. The fragment's grass branch (`uv.x < 5`) is the **same three-sub-blade wisp cutout** for both (`shaders.zig:1143-1161`); there is no bush-specific look. Only the geometry splay + spec scale differ. **Diagnosis holds: a bush is a bigger, wider, denser, outward-splayed grass tuft painted by the exact same fragment shader.**

**FLORA_KINDS / density maps**: bush is a single kind `'bush'`, lane `'bush'` (floraData.ts:28,54,68); `BUSH_KIND_LEVEL` only maps `'med'` (grassPopulation.ts:121) — sparse/lush levels exist in the spec but no tile lights them.

**world_loader shape ids**: `SHAPE_GRASS=6`, `SHAPE_BUSH=7`, `SHAPE_FROND=8`, `SHAPE_PALMTRUNK=9`, `SHAPE_FLOWER=10` (`world_loader.zig:101-105`). Grass, flower, bush all carry the `~grass~` tex key (draw nodes :4887-4922); frond carries `~frond~`; trunk carries none (lit mesh, :4938).

## ADD-A-KIND CHECKLIST (one new flora kind, e.g. oak, or a distinct bush)

**1. Painter kind tables — TWO clones must stay in sync:**
- `cart/hmsc-int/floraData.ts`: add to `FloraKind` union (:20-29), `FLORA_KIND_DEFINITIONS` label+color (:46-56), `FLORA_KIND_LAYER` lane (:60-70).
- `cart/editor/world/floraKinds.ts` (a hand-maintained CLONE, header note :1-2): mirror `FloraKind` (:11-20), `FLORA_KIND_DEFINITIONS` (:35-45), **and add a `[spec,count,chance]` triple to `FLORA_SPECS`** (:60-70) — this is the population contract pushed to the native live preview via `mapSetFloraSpecs` (`cart/editor/stage/mapPaint.ts:142`).

**2. Population spec + density (grassPopulation.ts or a new module):** new `*_CONFIG` table, `*_KIND_LEVEL`/`*_KIND_DENSITY` map, a `FoliageSpec`, `editorTunables().register` call, a new `FOLIAGE_SPEC_*` id (grassPopulation.ts:450-453), and routing in `foliageCells` (:466-489) or a new `*Cells` function.

**3. Geometry — editor twin + native twin:**
- `runtime/geometries/NewThing.ts` + export in `runtime/geometries/index.ts`.
- `world_loader.zig`: `buildNewThing()` (twin of the TS generator), `self.newthing = buildNewThing()` (~:4100), interned preview node (~:4722), batch draw node (~:4887), with its tex key.
- Wire into `cart/hmsc-int/editors/play/tsLoader/buildBuckets.ts` `planForShape` (:61-92) and a `*Field` in `GrassField.tsx` + mount in `GameWorld3D.tsx`.

**4. shapeId in `world_loader.zig`:** new `SHAPE_*` const (:63-116), bucket append in the instance loop (:1359-1377), add to `isFoliageShape` (:1651-1653), and a batch/geom-key node.

**5. `foliage.zig` recipe expansion:** new `FoliageConfig`/config const + a `*Row` generator (bladeRow-style :83-104); route it in the loader recipe loop (`world_loader.zig:1385-1432`) and the live-paint `regenPaintFoliage` switch (:7203-7250); **raise the family cap** `@min(3, …)` in `framework/game/map/engine.zig:908` and extend the `FloraSpec` doc (:891-898). Add a preview row cap constant (`world_loader.zig:86-90`).

**6. compile side `worldGeometry.ts`:** new `INSTANCE_SHAPE_*` const (:73-112), a `push*`/`pushInstanceField` call, and ensure `encodeFlora` (:1337-1359) includes the new cells.

**7. Shader routing:** reuse `~grass~`/`~frond~`, OR add a new tex key + pipeline — new `*_wgsl` in `shaders.zig`, `g_*_pipeline` var + `createRenderPipeline` (`3d.zig:4849/4895`), and a `startsWith` route entry (`3d.zig:6946-6948`, plus the proto-skip list `world_loader.zig:4143`).

**PARITY TESTS (must stay bit-exact):** `framework/world/foliage.zig:247-300` — golden-value tests `bladeRow` (:256), `flowerRow` (:271), `palmFrondRow` (:286), plus the `mix` hash test (:248). Goldens were generated from the TS source (`/tmp/foliage_golden.js`, noted :15). Any new `*Row` generator needs a matching golden test. **Caveat:** I found no explicit `foliage` test step in `build.zig` (grep empty); the tests compile only because `world_loader.zig:37` imports the module — verify with `zig build test-*` / `zig test framework/world/foliage.zig` before relying on them. The JS↔Zig hash twins that must match: `mix`/`unit` (`foliage.zig:21-32` vs `cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/scatter.ts`).

## CONSTRAINTS / CAPS

**24-byte `SlimInstance`** (`3d.zig:103-108`, packed by `makeSlimInstance` :6007-6020) — used by ALL card foliage (grass/bush/flower/frond via `~grass~`/`~frond~`). Baked-in per-family assumptions that constrain new tree shapes:
- `pos: f32x3`, `angles: u16x2` = **pitch, yaw ONLY** — `rz` (roll) is dropped, always 0 (comment :92, :6003).
- `scale: unorm16x2` = **one width + one length; sx==sz assumed** (:106, :6003) — no non-uniform horizontal scale on a card.
- `SLIM_SCALE_MAX = 16.0 m` (:102) — any card > 16 m clamps loudly (:6010). A tall tree crown card is bounded by this.
- color `unorm8x3` (+unused alpha) — a single root tint per card.
- **Consequence:** a card-based crown can only yaw+pitch, uniform horizontal scale, ≤16 m. **Trunks escape this** — they use the full 32-byte `InstanceData`/`makeInstance` lit-mesh path (:5993), so trunks get full euler rotation + non-uniform scale.

**Instance ceilings:**
- `MAX_STATIC_INSTANCES = 1,048,576` (`3d.zig:4165`); the slim scratch `MAX_INSTANCES` (:4185). JS mirror `MAX_INSTANCES = 1048576` (`grassPopulation.ts:88`), truncates LOUDLY (:352).
- `MAX_FRAME_VERTS = 262144` (`3d.zig:208`).

**Native live-preview row caps** (`world_loader.zig:86-90`): grass 262144, bush 65536, flower 65536, frond 262144, trunk 16384 — saturation logged per-family (:7256).

**Frond count budget per palm:** outer 12-18 + inner `max(5, round(outer·0.6))` (`palmPopulation.ts:35,181`; `foliage.zig` PALM :177-178, `PalmCrown.total` :194-196).

## TRUNK PROPS — placement, scale, bark

Palm trunk is a **distinct solid lit object** (per USER RULING), NOT a card and NOT recipe-ized (it bakes real rows):
- **Placement/scale** — `palmPopulation.ts` `pushTrunk` (:131-138): row at cell surface `top`; y-scale = `trunkH`; x/z scale = `span = radius / PALM_TRUNK_UNIT_RADIUS` (0.13) so the baked unit-space taper keeps proportion; yaw = `leanYaw`; shape = `INSTANCE_SHAPE_PALMTRUNK`. Bake: `buildPalmTrunkInstances` → `pushPalms` (`worldGeometry.ts:1225-1228`). Native twin: `regenPaintFoliage` spec 3 (`world_loader.zig:7213-7224`), constants `PALM_TRUNK_RADIUS_MIN/MAX` (:95-96), `PALM_TRUNK_UNIT_RADIUS` (:94).
- **Bark look — no shader, no texture.** The `PalmTrunk` GEOMETRY carries the entire bark read: taper + low bulge + horizontal scar-ring ripple + lean (`PalmTrunk.ts:42-48`, native `buildPalmTrunk` :1063). It draws through the **ordinary scene3d lit mesh pipeline** (no `~` tex key — `world_loader.zig:4938-4947`), and the per-instance row RGB (`PALM_CONFIG.trunkColor` / `PALM_TRUNK_COLOR`) flat-tints it. So "bark" = geometry silhouette + flat vertex color + standard scene lighting. A new tree trunk with real bark texture/shading would need either a new geometry or a new lit-mesh material — the trunk path is the flexible one (full `InstanceData`), unlike the constrained crown cards.</result>
